# Coupon

`promotional/coupon` &middot; content-level &middot; category: promotional

## Purpose

A ticket-style coupon: the value on a colored panel, with the description, code, expiry and a text link beside it.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | text |  |
| `code` | text |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `description` | text |  |
| `expires` | text |  |
| `cta` | cta { label, href } |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Accent value panel with a dashed border.
- **dark**: Primary-colored value panel. Sets `valueBackground: @colors.primary`, `valueColor: @colors.primaryText`, `borderColor: @colors.primary`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `valueBackground` | color | `"@colors.accent"` |
| `valueColor` | color | `"@colors.white"` |
| `valueSize` | length | `"28px"` |
| `textColor` | color | `"@colors.text"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `borderColor` | color | `"@colors.accent"` |
| `radius` | length | `"@radius.medium"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@spacing.sm 0"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Cells, colors and text honored. Dashed border can render solid. | Fine. Cells stay side by side on narrow phones, keep the value short. | Keeps its own colors. |



## Example usage

This is a content-level component: it goes inside a column, so put it in the `content` of a `layout/section` (or another layout).

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('promotional/coupon', {
  "value": "25% OFF",
  "description": "Your first order of $50 or more.",
  "code": "WELCOME25",
  "expires": "Expires 30 June",
  "cta": {
    "label": "Redeem online",
    "href": "https://example.com/discount/WELCOME25"
  }
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "promotional/coupon",
  "data": {
    "value": "25% OFF",
    "description": "Your first order of $50 or more.",
    "code": "WELCOME25",
    "expires": "Expires 30 June",
    "cta": {
      "label": "Redeem online",
      "href": "https://example.com/discount/WELCOME25"
    }
  }
}
```
